ipa.curves.zc_curves.CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing

Generates the Cross Currency curves for the definitions provided

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves.zc_curves.CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing.

Syntax

CrossCurrencyCurveDefinitionPricing(
    *,
    constituent_override_mode: ConstituentOverrideMode | None = None,
    main_constituent_asset_class: MainConstituentAssetClass | None = None,
    risk_type: RiskType | None = None,
    base_currency: OptStr = None,
    base_index_name: OptStr = None,
    id: OptStr = None,
    ignore_existing_definition: OptBool = None,
    is_non_deliverable: OptBool = None,
    name: OptStr = None,
    quoted_currency: OptStr = None,
    quoted_index_name: OptStr = None,
    source: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
constituent_override_mode ConstituentOverrideMode | None No None A method to use the default constituents. the possible values are: * replacedefinition: replace the default constituents by the user constituents from the input request, * mergewithdefinition: merge the default constituents and the user constituents from the input request, the default value is 'replacedefinition'. if the ignoreexistingdefinition is true, the constituentoverridemode is set to replacedefinition.
main_constituent_asset_class MainConstituentAssetClass | None No None The asset class used to generate the zero coupon curve. the possible values are:
* fxforward * swap
risk_type RiskType | None No None The risk type to which the generated cross currency curve is sensitive. the possible value is: * 'crosscurrency'
base_currency OptStr No None The base currency in the fxcross currency pair. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'eur').
base_index_name OptStr No None The name of the floating rate index (e.g., 'estr') applied to the base currency.
id OptStr No None The identifier of the cross currency definitions.
ignore_existing_definition OptBool No None An indicator whether default definitions are used to get curve parameters and constituents. the possible values are: * true: default definitions are not used (definitions and constituents must be set in the request), * false: default definitions are used.
is_non_deliverable OptBool No None An indicator whether the instrument is non-deliverable: * true: the instrument is non-deliverable, * false: the instrument is not non-deliverable. the property can be used to retrieve cross currency definition for the adjusted interest rate curve.
name OptStr No None The fxcross currency pair applied to the reference or pivot currency. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'eur usd fxcross').
quoted_currency OptStr No None The quoted currency in the fxcross currency pair. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'usd').
quoted_index_name OptStr No None The name of the floating rate index (e.g., 'sofr') applied to the quoted currency.
source OptStr No None A user-defined string that is provided by the creator of a curve. curves created by refinitiv have the 'refinitiv' source.
